snippet.title: Frisia - Tales & Tides | Gameplay Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
In Frisia Tales & Tides you start on an uninhabited Northsea island and are tasked with building a picturesque and cozy village in harmony with the sea.

Wishlist now on Steam and try out the demo for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578430/Frisia__Tales__Tides/
